lawyers-and-tech-ethics-experts-ai-weara.author: Alexandra Zandamela
lawyers-and-tech-ethics-experts-ai-weara.core: Posted in last 7 days Lawyers & Tech Ethics Experts - AI Wearables & Legal Journeys Every few months, I release a new season of the Lex & Lace Podcast, and it has become a ritual I look forward to. This season, I'll be exploring the tech advancements that are constantly reshaping our world, while also returning to the heart of the show's original message: the intersection of Law and Fashion. Episode 1 is a rundown of the summer's biggest tech and AI developments, including Meta Glasses, Jacob Coxon's warning, and Flock Cameras. Episode 2 is a tribute to my legal roots. I was joined by fellow lawyer Kiyala Matanga to discuss her legal journey through the lens of adversity and leadership, guided by faith. Kiyala was a joy to have on the pod, and our conversation reminded me that not everything has to be linear. Sometimes, you simply have to trust the process. Both episodes are available now on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and YouTube. And if you have a story you'd like to share, I'd love to hear from you. Reach out to be a guest on the pod! https://lnkd.in/dcKHYkDR Lex & Lace Podcast

indie-makers-product-journey-first-user-.core: Posted in last 7 days Indie Makers - Product Journey, First User & Paid Users HackerMRR is live! Hey guys, just wanted to share thathackermrr.comis live and you can share your product story. Since we have vibecoding, it's pretty easy to build things, but getting attention, users or even paying users is way more harder. So I built a place for everyone to share their product journey. It could be vibe coded or not, doesn't matter. HackerMRR is looking for stories where you can share how you made it, got your first user, paid users or even failed product. It's not where a person writes a story and I just upload it - no. It's way simpler. You just need to fill out a form where you will answer questions and after that, I will turn those questions into an interview like story and publish it in 24 hours! So? If you have a story to share, go ahead. I would love to have you before launching on other places. For now, I am just focusing on getting stories :) Thanks! Share it here - https://hackermrr.com/share HackerMRR
